topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 37 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 24 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20basic, blacklistable, basictoken). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
